legend: The Zoo in the Grid Kingdom is represented by an infinite grid. The Zoo has n observation binoculars located at the OX axis. For each i between 1 and n, inclusive, there exists a single binocular located at the point with coordinates (i, 0). There are m flamingos in the Zoo, located at points with positive coordinates. The flamingos are currently sleeping and you can assume that they don't move.

In order to get a good view over the flamingos, each of the binoculars can be independently rotated to face any angle (not necessarily integer). Then, the binocular can be used to observe all flamingos that is located at the straight line passing through the binocular at the angle it is set. In other words, you can assign each binocular a direction corresponding to any straight line passing through the binocular, and the binocular will be able to see all flamingos located on that line.

Today, some kids from the prestigious Codeforces kindergarten went on a Field Study to the Zoo. Their teacher would like to set each binocular an angle to maximize the number of flamingos that can be seen by the binocular. The teacher is very interested in the sum of these values over all binoculars. Please help him find this sum.
input: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 106, 1 ≤ m ≤ 250), denoting the number of binoculars and the number of flamingos, respectively.
Then m lines follow, the i-th line will contain two space-separated integers xi and yi (1 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 109), which means that the i-th flamingo is located at point (xi, yi).
All flamingos will be located at distinct points.
output: Print a single integer denoting the maximum total number of flamingos that can be seen by all the binoculars.
note: This picture shows the answer to the example test case.

legend.ai: 网格王国中的动物园由一个无限网格表示。动物园中有 n 个观测望远镜，它们位于 OX 轴上。对于 1 到 n 之间的每个 i（包含边界），都有一个观测望远镜位于坐标为 (i, 0) 的点上。动物园中有 m 只火烈鸟，它们位于坐标均为正的点上。火烈鸟目前正在睡觉，你可以认为它们不会移动。
为了更好地观察火烈鸟，每个观测望远镜都可以独立旋转，使其朝向任意角度（不一定是整数）。随后，可以使用该观测望远镜观察所有位于经过该望远镜且与其设置角度相同的直线上的火烈鸟。换句话说，你可以为每个观测望远镜指定一条经过它的任意直线作为方向，该观测望远镜便能够看到位于这条直线上的所有火烈鸟。
今天，来自著名 Codeforces 幼儿园的一些孩子前往动物园进行实地考察。他们的老师希望为每个观测望远镜设置一个角度，使该观测望远镜能够看到的火烈鸟数量最大化。老师非常关心这些最大值之和。请帮助他求出这个和。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6，1 ≤ m ≤ 250），分别表示观测望远镜和火烈鸟的数量。
接下来是 m 行，第 i 行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 xi 和 yi（1 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 10^9），表示第 i 只火烈鸟位于点 (xi, yi)。
所有火烈鸟都位于互不相同的点上。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示所有双筒望远镜能够看到的火烈鸟总数的最大值。

note.ai: 这张图展示了样例测试用例的答案。
